mentions.name: qage
mentions.description: A bug reporting tool that gives users a simpler way to report bugs and provides developers with a context-rich environment, including console and network logs, to make fixing bugs easier. Currently seeking beta testers via a waitlist.
mentions.problem: Bug reports lack the context (console/network logs) developers need, making bugs harder to fix
mentions.audience: Users reporting bugs and the developers who fix them
